summary: Run a playbook in the postgresql_ee EE against localhost with ansible-navigator run; gathered facts describe the container, not your machine.
questions: How do I run a playbook against localhost inside an EE?
Why do the facts show the container instead of my laptop?

answer_card.title: Run an EE against localhost
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-navigator run test_localhost.yml --execution-environment-image postgresql_ee --mode stdout --pull-policy missing
```
Facts describe the **container**, because the playbook runs inside it; `localhost` is the EE itself.
